evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Ratifying a contract invokes agreed process (legitimate) while supplying the authoritative facts of how it works (informational); the act of ratification itself signals expert authority over the design.

evidence.quote:
Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: Framing a design choice as a settled 'Key decision' supplies the controlling facts while presenting a logical either-or structure as rational justification.
